# Veterans Transition Lifecycle Assistant
> AI-powered voice assistant guiding veterans through a structured 5-phase transition journey: Intake → Gap Mapping → Curriculum Building → Learning → Interview Simulation

**System Overview:**
This context server provides structured scripts and resources for an OpenAI Realtime voice agent that guides veterans through career transition. Each phase includes conversation scripts, assessment frameworks, and contextual resources.

## Phase 1: Intake
- [Intake Script](/scripts/phase1-intake.md): Conversation flow for gathering veteran background
- [Military History Questions](/scripts/intake-military-history.md): MOS/Rating, rank, specialties, deployments
- [Career Exploration](/scripts/intake-career-exploration.md): Interest assessment and goal discovery
- [Learning Style Assessment](/scripts/intake-learning-style.md): Visual, auditory, kinesthetic, reading/writing preferences
- [Intake Completion Criteria](/scripts/intake-completion.md): Required information checklist

## Phase 2: Gap Mapping
- [Gap Analysis Script](/scripts/phase2-gap-mapping.md): Skills assessment conversation flow
- [Military Skills Database](/reference/military-skills.md): Comprehensive MOS/Rating to skills mapping
- [Civilian Requirements](/reference/civilian-requirements.md): Industry-specific skill requirements by career
- [Gap Identification Framework](/scripts/gap-identification.md): How to surface and prioritize skill gaps
- [Strength Recognition](/scripts/strength-recognition.md): Highlighting transferable military skills

## Phase 3: Curriculum Building
- [Curriculum Builder Script](/scripts/phase3-curriculum-building.md): Personalized learning path creation
- [Learning Module Library](/curriculum/module-library.md): Pre-built modules by skill area
- [Timeline Planning](/scripts/timeline-planning.md): Realistic milestone setting based on veteran's availability
- [Resource Recommendations](/curriculum/resources.md): Courses, certifications, books, practice platforms
- [Curriculum Review Process](/scripts/curriculum-review.md): Presenting and adjusting the plan with veteran input

## Phase 4: Learning
- [Learning Session Script](/scripts/phase4-learning.md): Guided instruction conversation flow
- [Module Delivery Patterns](/scripts/module-delivery.md): How to teach different content types
- [Progress Check-ins](/scripts/progress-checkins.md): Regular assessment and encouragement
- [Difficulty Adaptation](/scripts/difficulty-adaptation.md): Adjusting pace based on comprehension
- [Practice Exercises](/curriculum/exercises.md): Hands-on activities and drills by skill
- [Learning Resources](/curriculum/learning-resources.md): External materials organized by topic

## Phase 5: Interview Simulation
- [Interview Simulator Script](/scripts/phase5-interview-simulation.md): Realistic interview practice flow
- [Industry Scenarios](/interview/industry-scenarios.md): Role-specific interview simulations
- [Question Banks](/interview/question-banks.md): Behavioral, technical, and situational questions
- [Feedback Framework](/scripts/interview-feedback.md): Constructive evaluation and improvement suggestions
- [Mock Interview Types](/interview/interview-types.md): Phone screen, technical, panel, behavioral
- [Answer Frameworks](/interview/answer-frameworks.md): STAR method and other response structures

## Cross-Phase Resources
- [Military Terminology Translator](/reference/terminology.md): MOS/Rating to civilian job titles
- [Benefits and Programs](/reference/benefits.md): GI Bill, SkillBridge, VR&E, TAP
- [Crisis Resources](/reference/crisis-resources.md): Support contacts for challenging moments
- [Success Stories](/reference/success-stories.md): Real veteran transition journeys by career field
- [Credential Mapping](/reference/credentials.md): Military certifications to civilian equivalencies

## Voice Agent Guidance
- [Tone and Empathy](/guidance/tone.md): Military-friendly, respectful communication style
- [Phase Transitions](/guidance/phase-transitions.md): Moving smoothly between lifecycle phases
- [Motivation Techniques](/guidance/motivation.md): Encouragement patterns for different situations
- [Active Listening](/guidance/active-listening.md): Validation and reflection techniques
- [Crisis Response](/guidance/crisis-response.md): Recognizing distress and providing appropriate support

## Technical Integration
- [Session State Management](/integration/session-state.md): Tracking user progress across phases
- [Phase Progression Logic](/integration/phase-progression.md): When and how to advance phases
- [Context Retrieval](/integration/context-retrieval.md): Accessing relevant resources via MCP
- [OpenAI Realtime Configuration](/integration/openai-realtime.md): Voice API setup and parameters
